documentation_sources.name: CUDA Programming Guide - asynchronous data copies
documentation_sources.receipt_note: TMA handles one-dimensional and multidimensional bulk async copies; global-to-shared TMA read completion is tracked by shared-memory barriers, and low-level cp.async.bulk requires explicit expected-byte accounting.

documentation_sources.name: libcu++ PTX cp.async.bulk wrappers
documentation_sources.receipt_note: The wrapper documents the 16-byte source/destination alignment and 16-byte size-multiple requirements used by this receipt.

documentation_sources.name: CUTLASS CuTe TMA tensors
documentation_sources.receipt_note: CuTe TMA uses tensor-map/descriptor coordinates; descriptor construction is therefore a separate pass/fail gate from ordinary pointer copies.

documentation_sources.name: CuTe DSL cpasync submodule
documentation_sources.receipt_note: The CuTe DSL exposes tiled TMA atom construction and descriptor copy helpers for the Wave7 implementation prototype.
